interpretation.sessions: all 18 TEACH stations, then REPEAT on aligned bases on the same 0.2 s path clock; P-E revisits 1..3 are separate repeat alternatives sharing the same TEACH prefix; no travel or dwell assumed between sessions
interpretation.motion: 0.08 m/s and 0.3 rad/s, C3 arcs use 0.40m radius and 0.2 rad/s
interpretation.sweep: source main sequence including repeat attempts; station-local alignment to/from aligned base; nearest among same-station dense and TB3 stop poses (including P-E)
interpretation.dwell: 2s at each selected TB3 stop; TEACH logs have capture-end timestamps only and the verified scan file lacks per-scan time
interpretation.movement: all inter-station travel follows the frozen P-A_PRIME route; measured REPEAT and P-E offsets apply within each station visit
interpretation.total: P-A_PRIME totals plus station sweeps/alignments, or the corresponding standalone G0 route totals; integrate pose-table chords and wrapped yaw across sub-packet source vertices
interpretation.nearest: within both closed bounds, minimize squared axis errors normalized by bounds, then lowest production pose_id
interpretation.noise_seed: unique per packet (2026111503 << 32) | global sequence; nominal pose bank only
